criteria.text:
Given FAFF_RUN_DIR is unset
When `faff run trigger --json` runs
Then it exits 0 with token "skip" and classify.verdict "not-l4"
And verdict is null
criteria.exercised: docker exec -w /work/repo faff-holdout-1418-a sh -c 'unset FAFF_RUN_DIR; faff run trigger --json'
criteria.observed: exit 0; token "skip"; classify {verdict:"not-l4", reason:"no FAFF_RUN_DIR"}; verdict null

criteria.text:
Given FAFF_RUN_DIR names a directory with no run-ledger.json
When `faff run trigger --json` runs
Then it exits 3 with token "fault"
And no file under that directory is created or modified
criteria.exercised: FAFF_RUN_DIR=/tmp/eval/s2/rundir (holds only marker.txt, no run-ledger.json) faff run trigger --json; stat+sha256 of every entry before/after; repeated on an empty dir /tmp/eval/s2e/rd
criteria.expected: exit 3; token "fault"; no file under the dir created or modified
criteria.observed: exit 3; token "fault" (reason "FAFF_RUN_DIR names a dir with no run-ledger.json"); listing, sizes, mtimes and hash identical; empty dir still has 0 entries

criteria.text:
Given an L4 lights-out-shaped run directory as FAFF_RUN_DIR, tracking.repo and tracking.container unset, and one Active PRD with container "Demo" whose file exists
When `faff run trigger --json` runs without readiness input
Then it exits 0 with token "needs-judgement:prd-inputs"
And prd.path names the Demo PRD file and verdict is null
criteria.exercised: fixture /tmp/eval/fx3 (tracking.repo/container unset; faff prd new Demo --status Active), run dir minted by faff lights-out; FAFF_RUN_DIR=/tmp/eval/fx3/.faff/runs/run-20261101-221421-lights-out faff run trigger --json
criteria.expected: exit 0; token "needs-judgement:prd-inputs"; prd.path names the Demo PRD file; verdict null

criteria.text:
Given the same run directory and PRD, a readiness file holding one faff-contract:prd-readiness block with verdict "admissible", stop_conditions_verifiable true and creative_licence "tight", and a goals file ["g1"] where no live PRDR under "Demo" cites "g1"
When `faff run trigger --prd-readiness <file> --prd-goals <file> --json` runs
Then it exits 0 with token "plan" and verdict.reason "coverage-thin"
And creative_licence is "tight" and signals.outward is true
criteria.exercised: same fixture; FAFF_RUN_DIR=/tmp/eval/fx3/.faff/runs/run-20261101-221421-lights-out faff run trigger --prd-readiness readiness.out (one prd-readiness block: admissible, stop_conditions_verifiable true, creative_licence tight) --prd-goals ["g1"] --json; zero PRDRs under Demo (variant: one PRDR under Demo citing g2)
criteria.expected: exit 0; token "plan"; verdict.reason "coverage-thin"; creative_licence "tight"; signals.outward true
criteria.observed: exit 0; token "plan"; verdict {plan, coverage-thin}; creative_licence "tight"; signals.outward true (same with the g2 PRDR present)

criteria.text:
Given the same run directory and PRD and an admissible readiness file, and a goals file []
When `faff run trigger --prd-readiness <file> --prd-goals <file> --json` runs
Then it exits 3 with token "refuse" and verdict.reason "coverage-unmeasurable"
And diagnostics includes "prd-goals-empty"
criteria.exercised: same fixture and readiness file; FAFF_RUN_DIR=/tmp/eval/fx3/.faff/runs/run-20261101-221421-lights-out faff run trigger --prd-readiness readiness.out --prd-goals [] --json

criteria.text:
Given an L4 lights-out-shaped run directory as FAFF_RUN_DIR, tracking.repo set (so the target repo is the self repo) and no PRD file in the PRD directory
When `faff run trigger --json` runs
Then it exits 3 with token "refuse" and verdict.reason "self-directed"
And the run-ledger.json bytes are unchanged
criteria.exercised: fixture /tmp/eval/fx6 (tracking.repo acme/fx6, no docs/prd), run dir minted by faff lights-out; sha256 run dir files; FAFF_RUN_DIR=<rd> faff run trigger --json; sha256 again
criteria.expected: exit 3; token "refuse"; verdict.reason "self-directed"; run-ledger.json bytes unchanged
criteria.observed: exit 3; token "refuse"; verdict {refuse, self-directed}; run-ledger.json sha256 d6cd77fc… before and after
